components.html:
Plan your journey

Add your travel details to prepare a request.
components.css: .ds-details{font-family:var(--body);line-height:1.65;border-block:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink)}.ds-item{display:flex;align-items:center;position:relative;min-height:76px;padding:22px 35px 22px 0;font-size:1.125rem;font-weight:500;list-style:none;cursor:pointer}.ds-item::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-item:after{content:"";position:absolute;right:4px;top:50%;width:8px;height:8px;border-right:1px solid currentColor;border-bottom:1px solid currentColor;transform:translateY(-70%) rotate(45deg)}.ds-details[open]>.ds-item:after{transform:translateY(-20%) rotate(225deg)}.ds-item:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:5px}

narrative.overview: The user-pinned minimal revision uses white space, charcoal text, one Manrope family, natural photographs and modest dark buttons. Visible content covers three photo destinations plus six flight presets, student guidance, Dubai/Thailand holiday stories, an Everest experience, stays/transfers/visa itineraries, three planning steps, six FAQs and contact. Native disclosures contain the planner, preferences, FAQs and booking/privacy guidance.
keyCharacteristics: Single-family typography and quiet neutral hierarchy.
Unobscured photography, thin rules and no decorative shadows.
Visible travel guidance and actions; collapsed planner and FAQs.

rules.name: Request Boundary
rules.body: The planner prepares a request; the visitor chooses whether to send it in WhatsApp. Checkout is unimplemented, with no inventory provider or merchant account configured.

dos: Do preserve agency identity, contact defaults, photo credits and provenance.
Do preserve native controls, visible focus and progressive disclosure.
Do invalidate stale review and remove its WhatsApp href after journey changes or shortcuts.
donts: Don't restore condensed headings, colored service bands or an oversized permanent form panel.
Don't imply live inventory, confirmed booking, ticket issuance, automatic delivery or payment processing.
Don't store personal journey requests in the browser-only staff CMS or collect passport/card details in the planner.
